# fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role_detail (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role_detail" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  role_name   = "read-only"
}

output "iam_role_trusted_users" {
  value = data.fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role_detail.example.trusted_users
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_name` (String) The region name that's are the same with the region name in the S3 service. Currently, we have: HCM-01, HCM-02, HN-01, HN-02
- `role_name` (String) Name of the IAM role to query
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC ID

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The IAM role ARN
- `created_at` (String) When the IAM role was created
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `path` (String) The IAM role path
- `role_id` (String) The IAM role ID assigned by the storage platform
- `trusted_users` (List of String) Names of the IAM users allowed to assume this role
